definition.status: Read from docs/evidence/test-results.json, which is written only when someone runs `npm run evidence:record-tests` on a machine with the demo database (CI does not write it); this page never runs tests, and until that command has been run the file does not exist and this reads NOT_VERIFIED. PASS: a result was recorded against the code version currently checked out, with at least one check passed, none failed and none left unverified. FAIL: the recorded run for the current code version had failing checks. STALE: the recorded result belongs to a different code version than the one now checked out, or the current code version could not be determined, so it cannot be said to describe this version. NOT_VERIFIED: no readable result exists, or one exists but it is not a clean pass (nothing passed, or some checks were recorded as not verified). Only PASS means the checks were verified for this code version.
definition.scheduler: Two separate facts. (1) The latest recorded engine cycle (lastRunAt, lastStatus, lastDurationMs), taken from the run history whoever ran it: the scheduler, the seed script, automated tests or time travel. Its start time is real wall-clock time. (2) heartbeat: the most recent check-in of the instance marked as leader, when one has reported to this database. ageSeconds is the time since that check-in, measured on the same system clock the scheduler used to write it, so on a demo whose clock has been moved forward it is measured against that moved clock. heartbeat null means no scheduler instance currently marked as leader has reported to this database (a standby instance, or a leader that has shut down cleanly, is not shown); that does not by itself mean none is running (for example, none runs in a seeded demo database). A recent cycle without a heartbeat shows an engine run happened, not that a scheduler is running.
definition.stuckRuns: Runs still marked running more than 15 minutes of real elapsed time after they started, across ALL dates and with no filter: a crash, hard kill or out-of-memory stop cannot update its own row, so these are stuck, not in progress. 0 means none are recorded as stuck.
